name: read_file
description: Read a file by absolute or workspace-relative path. Returns the lines in [start, end] inclusive (1-indexed), or the whole file if `should_read_entire_file` is true and the file is small enough.

target_file.description: Path of the file to read.

should_read_entire_file.description: Read the whole file (rejected if > 1 MB).

name: write_file
description: Create or overwrite a file. Parent directories are created automatically. Prompts for approval unless in yolo mode.

content.description: Full file contents. The file is overwritten in its entirety.

name: edit_file
description: Replace one occurrence of `old_string` with `new_string`. Fails if `old_string` is not found, or is not unique in the file. Include enough context (3-5 lines above/below) to disambiguate.

name: delete_file
description: Delete a file. Fails silently if it does not exist. Does not delete directories — use run_command with rm -r for that, which asks for its own approval.

name: list_dir
description: List the contents of a directory. Returns up to 1000 entries. Each line is name followed by (file|dir|link) and size for files.

name: move_file
description: Move or rename a file or directory. Creates parent directories of the destination if needed.

name: copy_file
description: Copy a file. For directories, use run_command with cp -r.

name: make_dir
description: Create a directory (recursively — mkdir -p). No error if it already exists.

name: grep_search
description: Fast exact / regex search using ripgrep. Capped at 50 matches. Use for known symbols, function names, strings.

query.description: Regex pattern. Escape ( ) [ ] { } + * ? ^ $ | . \\ when searching literally.

name: file_search
description: Find files whose path contains the query substring (case-insensitive). Up to 10 hits. Use when you know part of a filename.

name: glob
description: List files matching a glob pattern (e.g. "src/**/*.ts"). Uses Node internal matcher — no external dependency.

name: run_command
description: Run a shell command in the user's current working directory. Prompts for approval unless in yolo mode. For long-running processes (servers, watchers), set is_background: true and the call returns a pid.

command.description: Full shell command. Quote arguments correctly.

is_background.description: Spawn and return a pid without waiting for exit.

timeout_ms.description: Max runtime in ms for foreground commands. Default 60000.

name: list_processes
description: List background processes started by run_command in this session (not every process on the system).

name: read_process_output
description: Read captured stdout/stderr of a background process started in this session. Returns the last N lines (default 200).

name: kill_process
description: Send a signal to a background process started in this session (only session-tracked pids — not arbitrary OS pids).

signal.description: POSIX signal name (SIGTERM, SIGKILL, …). Default SIGTERM. Ignored on Windows.

name: web_fetch
description: Fetch a URL and return its body. `as=markdown` strips HTML to text. Private-network addresses (10.x, 192.168.x, 127.x, cloud metadata) are blocked.

as.description: How to decode the body. Default text.

name: web_search
description: Search the web via DuckDuckGo. Returns top result titles, URLs, and snippets. No API key required.

num.description: Max results to return. Default 8, cap 20.

name: clipboard_read
description: Read the user's system clipboard. Returns text. Supported on macOS (pbpaste), Linux (xclip / xsel / wl-paste), Windows (PowerShell Get-Clipboard).

name: clipboard_write
description: Replace the user's system clipboard contents with text. Supported on macOS, Linux (xclip / wl-copy), Windows.

name: open_url
description: Open a URL in the user's default browser.

name: open_file
description: Open a file with the user's default application for its type (same as double-clicking it).

name: screenshot
description: Take a screenshot of the user's screen and save to out_path (default: ./screenshot-<timestamp>.png). Returns the path. Supported on macOS (screencapture), Linux (grim / gnome-screenshot / import), Windows (PowerShell).

out_path.description: Where to save the PNG. Default: screenshot-<ts>.png in cwd.

name: os_info
description: Return basic info about the host: platform, arch, cpu model, total/free memory, uptime, hostname, user, shell, node version.

name: env_get
description: Read one environment variable. Use env_list to see names first. Variables commonly containing secrets (TOKEN, KEY, SECRET, PASSWORD) require approval.

name: env_list
description: List names of environment variables (NOT values). Optional pattern filters the list.

name: notify
description: Show a desktop notification. macOS: osascript display notification. Linux: notify-send. Windows: PowerShell BurntToast if available, else a MessageBox.
